name: OS Client Certs -- cert9.db cleanup
description: ON-COMPOSE-ERROR-TRIGGER BUILD (v3, auto-retry), not for production: production testing showed cleanup + an IMMEDIATE resend (before trying to read anything) leaves reading intact, while resending from an already-observed-broken state does not recover it. This build automates that: auto-dismisses the modal "couldn't send" alert (matched by dialog id + .opener), runs cleanup, then automatically retries the send once (tracked send mode, retry-loop guard against retrying a retry).
